is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. M-form (page 1469).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotypes Vgsc L1014F (L995F), L1014S (L995S), N1575Y (N1570Y), and Ace-1 G119S (G280S) (page 1470).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper reports the 1014F kdr frequency (0.92) and the number of wild-caught females genotyped (n=74) (page 1470).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as gravid or blood-fed adults resting indoors in Akron, Porto-Novo, Benin in September 2009 (page 1469).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting original QTL mapping results (page 1468).

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is tied to Akron, Porto-Novo, Benin (lat: 4.4300; long: 2.6400) (page 1469).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper describes a primary study with new field collections and crosses specifically for this QTL mapping project.

supplement.evidence: The essential genotype frequencies and sample sizes for the field population are provided in the main text (page 1470).

assessment.summary: The study uses QTL mapping on isofemale pedigrees established from wild-caught Anopheles gambiae (M-form, now An. coluzzii) from Akron, Benin, collected in 2009. It identifies two QTLs associated with permethrin resistance on chromosomes 2L and 3R. Genotype frequencies for Vgsc L1014F/S, N1575Y, and Ace-1 G119S are reported for the field-collected females (n=74).
